subtitle.en: Advanced deposition, epitaxy, interfaces, and thin-film engineering

description.en: A quantitative engineering textbook on thin-film growth, surface reactions, interfaces, characterization, and integration. Simulator outputs are illustrative and are not fab-calibrated process recipes.
